title_en: Hasbro Reevals Some Incredible New Marvel Legends and G.I. Joe Classified Series Figures Exclusive to Target's Fall Geek Out Event
summary_en: Hasbro has revealed some drool-worthy new Marvel and G.I. Joe figures that will be exclusive to Target stores this fall.
body_en:
Hasbro has a new lineup of Marvel and G.I. Joe figures lined up as part of Target's Fall Geek Out event. IGN can exclusively reveal the latest addition to the G.I. Joe Classified Series line, featuring everyone's favorite mute ninja, and we can also reveal new preorder details for Hasbro's two newest Marvel Legends figures.
Scroll down to see images and details for all these upcoming Target-exclusive releases.
Snake Eyes remains one of the most popular and iconic characters in the G.I. Joe franchise, and that means he's one of the most perpetually in-demand figures in the G.I. Joe Classified Series lineup. This two-pack gives collectors another chance to own Snake Eyes, along with his faithful ninja partner Jinx. Both characters are decked out in their Ninja Force costumes and include plenty of accessories to match.
Preorders for this set open on the Target website on September 18 at 6am PT, with a release window of October 2026.
Hasbro is slowly giving New Mutants fans the full, classic team lineup in action figure form. This Cypher figure features Doug Ramsey in his classic team costume and includes various alternate hands and a techno-organic sword accessory. The figure also comes packaged inside the retro Toy Biz-style X-men cardback.
Preorders for this Cypher figure open on the Target website on September 18 at 6am PT, with a release window of Fall 2026.
MCU collectors will want to keep an eye out for this figure, which depicts Tom Holland's Spidey wearing the "Final Swing Suit" costume from the closing scene of 2021's Spider-Man: No Way Home. The figure incldues alternate hands and an additional partially unmasked head sculpt.
Preorders for this Spider-Man figure open on the Target website on September 18 at 6am PT, with a release window of Fall 2026.
In other collectibles news, the Marvel Masterworks line is making a comeback , and Hot Toys revealed a new Victor von Doom figure featuring an alternate costume for the Avengers: Doomsday villain.
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
